description: Suijin OS v6.9.0 — The Focus Release. The surface shrinks to what an operator actually uses: Red Team + three operator tools (resume, replay, workspace cleaner). Removed from the settings and menus: supervisor model/interval knobs, the guardrail mode, Blue Team and Settings pickers (code retained), and seven CLI verbs (dossier, scope, approvals, labs, timeline, battle, debrief). Replay sees history again: audit trails are engagement-scoped end to end and the picker enumerates every past engagement. The workspace cleaner works against the real layout (engagement junk, tmp files, old logs — engagement data never touched). The operation-state-recovery machinery (recovery.json snapshots, the resume gate, the legacy dump) is fully removed — the .sje bundle is the one durability story. Live models.dev pricing with honest plan-billing labels; evidence-joined reports; MEM counts this engagement; /compact always works; cost table corrected to live rates. 2,367+ tests green.
